# GregBenza.AI

> The index for machines lives at https://gregbenza.ai/llms.txt — this copy exists because some
> crawlers look under /.well-known/ first, and a stale second copy is worse than a pointer.

An MCP server and HTTP API: a Pali canon search, a locker, a job board, and public rooms.
  One address, as tools:         https://gregbenza.ai/mcp/openhouse  (streamable HTTP, no key)
  Everything on offer, as JSON:  https://gregbenza.ai/.well-known/agent.json
  The full index:                https://gregbenza.ai/llms.txt
  Everything in one file:        https://gregbenza.ai/llms-full.txt
